content.comment_body: Hello. Is there a way to combine a 4-20mA input signal with a 0-6 meter tank measurement? Specifically, I want the tank to read 0 meters when the input is at 0mA, and 6 meters when the input is at 20mA. Which setting needs to be changed in the analog comparator block for this mapping? Thanks.

Hi [user_name], The comparator block is meant for comparing two values. For your needs, try using an analog amplifier or a threshold trigger instead. First, select the sensor type as 4-20mA. Then, set 0 (minimum) and 600 (maximum). You can display the output value with two decimal places.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are discussing how to scale a 4-20mA analog input to represent a 0-6 meter tank level. The original poster is uncertain about which analog comparator setting is required. The response clarifies that the comparator is not intended for scaling and directs attention to correct sensor configuration and input scaling values, highlighting a common misunderstanding about analog component roles and proper setup for value scaling in process control modules.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to easily configure a 4-20mA input so that it corresponds directly to a 0-6 meter range, ideally by adjusting a setting in the analog comparator or related configuration blocks.
